code:
import numpy as np, requests
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import pandas as pd, matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg'); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
pdbtext=requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q96AA3-F1-model_v6.pdb').text
atoms=[]
for line in pdbtext.splitlines():
    if line.startswith('ATOM'):
        atoms.append((int(line[22:26]),line[17:20].strip(),line[12:16].strip(),
                      (line[76:78].strip() or line[12:16].strip()[0]),
                      float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54]),float(line[60:66])))
df=pd.DataFrame(atoms,columns=['resseq','resn','name','elem','x','y','z','b']); df=df[df.elem!='H'].reset_index(drop=True)
a3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
ri=df.groupby('resseq').agg(resn=('resn','first')).reset_index().sort_values('resseq'); ri['aa']=ri.resn.map(a3); seq=''.join(ri.aa); N=len(seq)
ca=df[df.name=='CA'].sort_values('resseq').reset_index(drop=True); plddt=ca['b'].values; ca_xyz=ca[['x','y','z']].values
coords=df[['x','y','z']].values; vdw={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80,'P':1.80}
radii=df.elem.map(vdw).fillna(1.70).values+1.4
i=np.arange(192)+0.5; phi=np.arccos(1-2*i/192); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*i
Sp=np.c_[np.sin(phi)*np.cos(th),np.sin(phi)*np.sin(th),np.cos(phi)]
tree=cKDTree(coords); maxr=radii.max(); sasa=np.zeros(len(df)); ev=np.zeros((len(df),3))
for k in range(len(df)):
    r=radii[k]; pts=coords[k]+Sp*r; ne=[j for j in tree.query_ball_point(coords[k],r+maxr) if j!=k]
    if ne:
        nc=coords[ne]; nr=radii[ne]; free=~(((pts[:,None,:]-nc[None,:,:])**2).sum(2)<(nr[None,:]**2)).any(1)
    else: free=np.ones(192,bool)
    sasa[k]=free.mean()*4*np.pi*r*r
    if free.any(): ev[k]=Sp[free].mean(0)
df['sasa']=sasa; df['ex'],df['ey'],df['ez']=ev.T
maxasa={'A':129,'R':274,'N':195,'D':193,'C':167,'E':223,'Q':225,'G':104,'H':224,'I':197,'L':201,'K':236,'M':224,'F':240,'P':159,'S':155,'T':172,'W':285,'Y':263,'V':174}
rs=df.groupby('resseq')['sasa'].sum(); rsasa=np.array([rs[i]/maxasa[seq[i-1]] for i in range(1,N+1)])
core=ca_xyz[rsasa<0.15]; cen=core.mean(0); _,_,vt=np.linalg.svd(core-cen,full_matrices=False); nrm=vt[0]
bz=(core-cen)@nrm; lo,hi=np.percentile(bz,[10,90]); memc=(lo+hi)/2; memh=(hi-lo)/2
def feat(p):
    sc=df[(df.resseq==p)&(~df.name.isin(['N','C','O','CA']))][['x','y','z']].values
    if len(sc)==0: sc=df[(df.resseq==p)&(df.name=='CA')][['x','y','z']].values
    sc=sc.mean(0); v=sc-cen; z=v@nrm; rv=v-z*nrm; rad=np.linalg.norm(rv); rh=rv/(rad+1e-9)
    sub=df[df.resseq==p]; w=sub['sasa'].values; e=(sub[['ex','ey','ez']].values*w[:,None]).sum(0); e=e/(np.linalg.norm(e)+1e-9)
    return z-memc,rad,float(e@rh)
Z=np.zeros(N);R=np.zeros(N);RO=np.zeros(N)
for p in range(1,N+1): Z[p-1],R[p-1],RO[p-1]=feat(p)
inmem=np.abs(Z)<memh
# plot
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5.5))
m=inmem&(rsasa>0.03)
sc0=ax[0].scatter(R[m],RO[m],c=rsasa[m],cmap='viridis',s=18,alpha=.6)
for p,cl in [(67,'red'),(152,'orange'),(298,'magenta')]:
    ax[0].scatter(R[p-1],RO[p-1],c=cl,s=220,edgecolor='k',zorder=5)
    ax[0].annotate(f'{seq[p-1]}{p}',(R[p-1],RO[p-1]),textcoords='offset points',xytext=(6,6),fontsize=12,fontweight='bold')
ax[0].axhline(0.75,ls='--',c='gray'); ax[0].axhline(-0.07,ls='--',c='blue')
ax[0].text(28,0.78,'lipid-facing median (+0.75)',fontsize=8,color='gray')
ax[0].text(28,-0.03,'axis-facing median (-0.07)',fontsize=8,color='blue')
ax[0].set_xlabel('radial distance of side chain from pore axis (Å)'); ax[0].set_ylabel('exposure radial-out\n(-1 opens to central cavity, +1 opens to lipid)')
ax[0].set_title('RFT1 (Q96AA3) TM residues: cavity vs lipid orientation'); plt.colorbar(sc0,ax=ax[0],label='rSASA (burial)')
# panel 2: burial vs radial
ax[1].scatter(R[m],rsasa[m],c='lightgray',s=16)
for p,cl in [(67,'red'),(152,'orange'),(298,'magenta')]:
    ax[1].scatter(R[p-1],rsasa[p-1],c=cl,s=220,edgecolor='k',zorder=5)
    ax[1].annotate(f'{seq[p-1]}{p}',(R[p-1],rsasa[p-1]),textcoords='offset points',xytext=(6,6),fontsize=12,fontweight='bold')
ax[1].axvline(10,ls=':',c='blue'); ax[1].axvline(18,ls=':',c='gray')
ax[1].text(4,0.9,'central\ncavity',color='blue',fontsize=9); ax[1].text(20,0.9,'lipid\nfacing',color='gray',fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_xlabel('radial distance from pore axis (Å)'); ax[1].set_ylabel('rSASA (relative burial)')
ax[1].set_title('Burial vs centrality of CDG residues')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('rft1_cavity_portal.png',dpi=150,bbox_inches='tight')
print('membrane center/half',round(memc,1),round(memh,1))
print('CDG residue features (z rel memc, radial, exp_radial_out):')
for p in [67,152,298]: print(f'  {seq[p-1]}{p}: z={Z[p-1]:+.1f} radial={R[p-1]:.1f} exp_out={RO[p-1]:+.2f} rSASA={rsasa[p-1]:.2f}')
print('saved rft1_cavity_portal.png')
